dont_miss_closes.one: Settle the Grove first: going to the Shadow-Cursed Lands or Rosymorn Monastery Trail before Kagha's ritual is stopped ends the tiefling and goblin quests. Other Act 1 gear stays reachable until you enter the Shadowfell in the Gauntlet of Shar, then every Act 1 place closes for good.
dont_miss_closes.two: Save the Gauntlet of Shar for last: entering the Shadowfell ends trading at Moonrise Towers and Dammon's crafting. Dammon also leaves when you enter the Mind Flayer Colony.

dont_miss.text: Kagha carries it. Kill her, or keep her alive: convince her to switch sides during Investigate Kagha, then after the camp celebration find her alone on the path into the Grove and knock her out with non-lethal attacks to loot her. She wakes after a long rest upset but not hostile, and trading with her mends things. Koll's table has one just before the final battle, but taking it counts as theft: he vanishes and nearby allies turn hostile.
Zevlor's reward for dealing with Kagha, so report back to him. If he's dead there's no reward, though he can also be looted or robbed.

Accept Zevlor's money after saving the refugees: the crown is in the Patched-Together Sack. If you decline, he sells it until your next long rest. He doesn't give it if Minthara leads the attack on the Grove.

Earn Mol's trust by helping the tiefling children, then steal the idol from the druids and give it to her before the tieflings leave the Grove. Her journal line says she'll repay you in Baldur's Gate, so the ring may come late.
Convince Cal, Lia and Rolan to stay in the Grove, and keep Mattis alive. Otherwise he doesn't open a shop at Last Light Inn.

The Strange Ox has it. Don't attack it at Last Light Inn if you want the quest: in Rivington in Act 3, smuggle it in as the Strange Apple, and be sure to pick the apple up before entering the Lower City. Killing it also drops the ring.
Auntie Ethel only has it in Act 3, in her lair under the Blushing Mermaid. She won't be there if she never leaves her Sunlit Wetlands lair, so confront her at the Riverside Teahouse in Act 1.
Auntie Ethel only gives it if you let her go when she begs for her life in her lair. Killing her loses it, and the trick of taking it and then killing her doesn't work in multiplayer.

Give Zarys the unopened chest for Harold and Brem's special stock. Don't make the deal with Rugan to fake the lost shipment. If you did, kill Rugan and Olly before entering the hideout to keep both rewards, or execute Rugan when Zarys demands it to get the stock without Harold. Anything else turns the base hostile. Lann Tarv at Moonrise sometimes offers the Titanstring Bow if Brem's stock was never unlocked.

Rescue Florrick from the burning inn at Waukeen's Rest, then pick this as one of her three rewards. Once you're close enough for the party to comment, long resting, fast travelling or going to Rosymorn Monastery Trail kills her.
Volo sells it, or Grat while Volo is his prisoner. Grat stops selling it once Volo leaves the camp, even if Volo later dies, so buy it before Volo can be lost.
Buy from Grat before you attack the goblin camp. He closes his shop if the goblins go on high alert.
Gut and Minthara carry these, so fight them at the goblin camp and loot them. Knocking Minthara out still lets you loot her. If you side with the goblins, Minthara leaves the Sanctum instead.
Don't kill Roah Moonglow at the goblin camp: she sells these at Moonrise Towers in Act 2. If you've killed everyone in the Zhentarim Basement, don't mention it to her, or she only trades once more.
There's only one: in Gut's private chambers, or from Omeluum after the parasite quest. Whichever you reach first removes the other.

Don't push Corsair Greymon off the raft during the cutscene: his body and the bow sink for good. Let him sail to Grymforge and buy it, or knock him in during the fight, and he washes up near the Decrepit Village's southern pier.
Omeluum only sells these after Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite: bring Timmask Spores and Tongue of Madness. It won't trade in Act 3. Attacking Omeluum or Blurg makes them teleport away.
Don't attack or get caught robbing Blurg in the Underdark. He and Omeluum can disappear.
In the Arcane Tower, behind an Animated Armour: break the Stool of Hill Giant Strength to get the club. Sitting on it does nothing lasting.
They're on Nere's corpse, so make sure he dies in Grymforge and loot him. If he lives on loyal to the Absolute, he turns up later as a zombie.
Buy from Jeera before any fight breaks out in the Crèche.

Protect Isobel when Marcus attacks Last Light Inn. If she's taken, everyone at the inn except Jaheira turns into shadow-cursed undead, Talli included. That also ends the other Last Light shops and rewards.

Dammon makes the set in order: armour, helmet, then gloves, so you need three pieces of Infernal Iron. He stops crafting once you enter the Shadowfell. The Gauntlet of Shar's own two pieces are near Balthazar and on Yurgir, so go for them before stepping through.
Dammon's Act 2 stock, so he has to survive the Grove and Isobel's fight. Buy before you enter the Mind Flayer Colony.

Meet Kagha before rescuing Halsin, or Arabella dies, and save the Grove. In Act 2, agree to find her parents and send her to camp. If you refuse, or tell her they're dead before she reaches camp, she can run off.
Do Moonrise Towers before the Shadowfell: entering it ends normal trading there and finishes much of its content for you. Don't knock out Lann Tarv, or he can't trade again.
Buy from Araj at Moonrise. She only returns in Act 3 if someone donated blood to her, and only trades there if you agree to her new experiment. Telling her "Keep your gold" makes her leave Moonrise.

Alfira gives it once the tieflings are back at Last Light Inn, so she must be alive. Get every prisoner out together: anyone left in Moonrise's prison when you move to the docks stays behind and dies.

Keep Shadowheart away from Ferg Drogher. He sells nothing with her nearby unless she stayed with Shar, and if she rejected Shar he leaves for good. The robe also needs a Persuasion check for his special stock.
Lucretious's reward for Find Dribbles the Clown. You can also pickpocket them or loot her.
Take them before Gortash's coronation. Afterwards, taking them turns Gortash and that floor's Steel Watchers hostile.

Don't take the amulet straight from the offering chest, or you're cursed: drag it to the floor first, or smash the chest. Buy The Reviving Hands first, or have someone else talk to Vicar Humbletoes afterwards. He won't trade with anyone who stole from the basement.
In vault nº9 of the Counting House. Return Rakath's Gold gives you a key.
The Steel Watcher Titan doesn't drop it if the killing blow comes from the Atrophied condition.
Buy from Mystic Carrion before siding with Thrumbo or breaking his organ jars. Either one turns him hostile.
Viconia carries it, so you have to fight her in the Cloister. Handing Shadowheart over makes her an ally instead.
Buy at Sorcerous Sundries before Lorroakan dies. After that, the counter only sells scrolls.

Buy at Sorcerous Sundries from Rolan, or from Lorroakan's Projection if Rolan is dead. If Lorroakan dies while Rolan lives, Rolan only carries it for a short time. If both are dead or gone, it's unavailable.

Don't steal from Helsik before she hands over the ritual items: she throws you out and seals the door, and she attacks if you come back. So leave the Mask for later. Her curated stock needs Perception checks and an Arcana check in conversation to unlock.
It's destroyed if Astarion becomes a Vampire Ascendant, if his ritual is interrupted, or if you leave the spawn behind after Cazador.
Both sit in globes in Ramazith's Tower. Bring See Invisibility to reveal the lever. Each person gets one Arcana check, DC 20, to open a globe, and a failed try triggers a trap.
These are in the House of Hope, through the portal in Helsik's shop. Haarlep wears the gloves, so they must die. Each person gets one try at the Wisdom and Arcana checks to open the staff's vault.
